title: 第 3 课 · 点亮 LED：限流电阻与极性
summary: LED 有正负极，还必须串一个电阻。电阻值怎么算？
concepts: forward voltage Vf 正向压降
description:
【LED 有方向（polarity）】
LED（发光二极管）只让电流从正极 anode（长脚）流向负极 cathode（短脚）。插反了不会坏，但不会亮。

【LED 两端的电压几乎固定】
LED 导通后两端的电压差约等于它的正向压降 Vf（forward voltage）：红 ≈ 1.8V，黄 ≈ 2.0V，绿 ≈ 2.1V，蓝 / 白 ≈ 3.0V。电源多出来的电压必须由别的元件“吃掉”，否则电流会非常大、LED 会烧掉。

【限流电阻（current-limiting resistor）】
电阻和 LED 串联（series），流过它们的电流相同。电阻两端的电压 = 电源电压 − Vf，所以：
  R = (V电源 − Vf) / I
例：5V 电源、绿色 LED（Vf ≈ 2.1V）、想要约 20mA：R = (5 − 2.1) / 0.02 ≈ 145Ω，选最接近的常用值 150Ω。实际电流约 18mA。一般 LED 电流 5–20mA 就够亮，不要超过 25mA。

【顺序无所谓】
电阻放在 LED 前面还是后面都可以：串联电路里电流处处相等。

本课用 5V 面包板电源模块（power module）供电，tests 会检查 LED 亮，并测量电阻两端的电压（应该约 2.7V ≈ 5 − 2.1 − LED 内阻上的一点点）。

en.title: Lesson 3 · Light an LED: current-limiting resistor and polarity
en.summary: An LED has a positive and a negative side, and it always needs a resistor in series. How do you work out the resistor value?
en.description:
**LEDs have a direction (polarity)**
An LED (light-emitting diode) only lets current flow from the anode (long lead, positive) to the cathode (short lead, negative). Plugged in backwards it won't be damaged, but it won't light either.

**The voltage across an LED is almost fixed**
Once an LED conducts, the voltage across it is roughly its forward voltage Vf: red ≈ 1.8V, yellow ≈ 2.0V, green ≈ 2.1V, blue / white ≈ 3.0V. The rest of the supply voltage has to be "used up" by some other part; otherwise the current gets huge and the LED burns out.

**Current-limiting resistor**
The resistor and the LED are in series, so the same current flows through both. The voltage across the resistor = supply voltage − Vf, so:
  R = (V_supply − Vf) / I
Example: 5V supply, green LED (Vf ≈ 2.1V), aiming for about 20mA: R = (5 − 2.1) / 0.02 ≈ 145Ω; pick the nearest common value, 150Ω. The actual current is about 18mA. LEDs are usually bright enough at 5–20mA; don't go above 25mA.

**Order doesn't matter**
The resistor can go before or after the LED: in a series circuit the current is the same everywhere.

This lesson is powered by a 5V breadboard power module. The tests check that the LED is on and measure the voltage across the resistor (it should be about 2.7V ≈ 5 − 2.1 − a little bit across the LED's internal resistance).
steps: Plug the breadboard power module into column 1 (set to 5V). It plugs into tp1 / tn1 / bp1 / bn1 at the same time, so both the top and bottom pairs of rails are powered.
Red jumper tp4 → a4, bringing +5V to column 4.
Put the 150Ω resistor between b4 and b8 (a resistor has no polarity, either lead is fine).
Green LED: long lead (anode, positive) in c8, connected to the resistor; short lead (cathode, negative) in c11. The long lead must face the + side!
Blue jumper a11 → tn11: the LED's cathode goes back to GND. Do the math: I ≈ (5 − 2.1) / 150 ≈ 19mA.
hints: LED not lighting? First check whether it is in backwards: long lead toward the resistor / + side, short lead to GND.
R = (V − Vf) / I. A green LED's Vf is about 2.1V.
tests: LED on, about 2.7V across the resistor

steps.text: 把面包板电源模块插在第 1 列（设为 5V）。它会同时插进 tp1 / tn1 / bp1 / bn1：上下两组电源轨都有电了。
红色跳线 tp4 → a4，把 +5V 引到第 4 列。
150Ω 电阻插在 b4 和 b8 之间（电阻没有正负，哪只脚都行）。
绿色 LED：长脚（anode，正极）插 c8，接电阻；短脚（cathode，负极）插 c11。长脚要朝向 + 那一侧！
蓝色跳线 a11 → tn11，LED 负极回到 GND。算一算：I ≈ (5 − 2.1) / 150 ≈ 19mA。

hints: LED 不亮？先看是不是插反了：长脚接电阻 / + 那侧，短脚接 GND。
R = (V − Vf) / I。绿色 LED 的 Vf 约 2.1V。
